lines.name: Family Empowerment Scholarship for Students with Unique Abilities
lines.wording: You may qualify if the student has a disability
lines.eligibility: This branch is for students with disabilities, as young as 3. Families can use an education savings account for approved expenses, including private school tuition. An approved scholarship funding organization determines eligibility.

lines.name: Florida Tax Credit Scholarship
lines.eligibility: The Florida Tax Credit Scholarship gives priority to students in households at or below 185 percent of the federal poverty level and to students in foster or out-of-home care, then to households up to 400 percent. Starting in the 2023-24 school year, the income cap for participation was removed. Scholarship funding organizations set the award.
